decisions.statement: The rows are read from every file the property has, in the order those files are numbered.
The rows are laid out again from the first file on.
The ceiling divided at is the ceiling one file beside a page is held to.
A file the new layout does not name is taken away.
A file already holding what the layout says is left alone.
A page naming no file for the property refuses the change.
No row's text changes and no row changes its place in the order.

definition: one page property's rows laid out again across as many files as the ceiling takes
